Bloomberg Tax reported on 2025-03-18 that the group being assembled for Treasury's Equity Hub was placed on administrative leave within days of the inauguration. A Federal Register search found the last meeting notice of the Treasury Advisory Committee on Racial Equity dated 2024-08-01 and no later notice, including no termination notice.

title: Eliminate Treasury's racial equity counselor, advisory committee and DEIA office
uncertainties: EO 14151 (90 FR 8339) was reread on federalregister.gov in review on 2026-10-18; section 2(b)(i) is government-wide and names neither Treasury nor advisory committees. Federal Register API queries since 2025-01-20 for the committee name (researcher, zero results) and for the term racial equity in Treasury documents (review, one OMB-led financial assistance proposed rule of 2026-05-29 that is unrelated) found no meeting or termination notice; absence of a notice is not proof that the committee ended. The committee charter of 2024-03-22 on home.treasury.gov was read only in part in review (the text ended in section 8), so its duration terms were not seen. The Bloomberg Tax article is paywalled, was read in part in an earlier review, and does not mention the counselor, committee or DEIA office; the Equity Hub it describes sits in the IRS. Two web searches (researcher and review) for a Treasury termination announcement returned only 2023 and 2024 committee materials and commentary. Other Treasury committee and HR pages could not be opened. The Unified Agenda and govinfo were not checked. The personnel steps on page 708 were not found.
